purpose: Build the real MVP OMI path where raw idea input produces structured, evidence-backed review candidates for owner review.

owner_override.historical_owner_gate_status: accepted by explicit owner decision but not full MVP completion

current_gap: Backend deterministic marker extraction now identifies evidence-backed candidates from explicit raw idea markers.
Frontend OMI API/UI surfaces do not yet trigger extraction or list extracted candidates for owner review.
Dedicated T005 persistence hardening remains next for evidence/provenance/source-span persistence boundaries.
mvp_behavior: User enters or saves a raw idea in OMI.
The system analyzes the raw idea.
The system identifies review candidates from that raw idea.
The UI lists those candidates for owner review.
acceptance_criteria: Given raw idea text, OMI produces non-empty candidate records where evidence exists.
Candidate list is visible in UI.
Each candidate has type, label/name, extracted claim, evidence/source excerpt or locator, provenance, status, and owner decision state.
Empty extraction fails closed with a clear explanation and does not create misleading empty shells.
UI clearly separates extracted candidates from approved Memory/Canon.
ui_ux_scope: Clear next action after candidate extraction.
boundaries: candidate approval does not automatically mutate Memory/Canon

no candidates created in parent publication
